Module is set up and working:

- **`go.mod`** — module `systool`, requiring `golang.org/x/sys v0.48.0` (latest, exact pin as `go.mod` always is).

Verified it cross-compiles clean for `linux/amd64`, `darwin/arm64`, and `windows/amd64`, and ran it locally (`Linux 6.8.0-139-generic`). `golang.org/x/sys` is the right choice here since it's the extended syscall package Go's team maintains specifically for OS calls the standard `syscall` package doesn't expose, with per-OS subpackages (`unix`, `windows`) — swap in whichever low-level calls your CLI actually needs behind the same `platformInfo`-style build-tag split.
